The '''7085 ionization reactor and regulator''' was a type of [[ionization reactor]] manufactured by [[Mason-Branger]]. The [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] had them installed in their [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]].
